title: Stop Strategy-Hopping — Build a System You'll Actually Follow.
description:
A strategy only works if you actually stick to it — but most traders abandon a system the second it has a losing streak and chase the next shiny one. That's strategy-hopping, and it's why nothing ever compounds. Here's how to build a strategy you'll actually follow. From a Former NYSE ARCA Market Maker.
